summary: 200 Cookies (25 batches: 25 Flour, 50 Eggs, 25 Sticks) and seven Cookie Shops (56 Bricks, 21 Planks). Build the whole chain from nothing: Lumberjacks, Clay Pit, Brickyard, Sawmill, Farm with about 30 Wheat tiles, Windmill and three or four Chicken Coops. Only two or three shops need staff.

build_order.note: About 30 tiles as soon as the Farm stands; 12-day crop.
Three or four; 50 Eggs are needed.
5 Stone + 15 Clay; two Quarries are already built.
Seven needed; staff two or three, the rest only need to exist.
Optional 150 Logs: replant Pine and keep the Lumberjacks working near the end.

pitfalls: Seven shops with two workers each would pull fourteen villagers off supply chains; leave most unstaffed.
Cookie Shops also burn a Stick for their fire; keep a Stick reserve.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
